title: Adder Factory
prompt: Implement make_adder(n) returning a function that adds n to its argument. This is a closure: the returned function remembers n.

tests.name: remembers its n
tests.hint: The inner function must capture n from make_adder.

tests.name: independent adders
tests.code:
a = make_adder(1)
b = make_adder(100)
assert a(0) == 1 and b(0) == 100
tests.hint: Each returned function keeps its own captured n.
